title: BOCCHI
unsupported_zone: Go to Occult Crescent (South or North Horn) to use BOCCHI.

support.kofi_tooltip: ♥ Ko-fi (so you can keep touching grass)

status.emergency_stop_tooltip: Emergency Stop — stop all automation, movement, and buffs

pot_timer.unknown: Next pot: unknown — stay for one pot FATE to start the timer.

buffs.title: Buffs
buffs.apply_tooltip: Cast your configured buffs now. Stand inside the knowledge crystal buff circle first — this button does not walk you there.

completionist.mode_off_left_zone: [BOCCHI] Left Occult Crescent — Completionist Mode Off
completionist.description: Missing notes from FATEs and Critical Encounters use Illegal Mode (same travel and combat settings). Survey points: click to flag the map; Ctrl+click to travel there (walk, nearby aethernet, or Return when shorter — mounts while walking). The list follows South or North Horn. Forked Tower notes are tracking-only.
completionist.legend: Check = unlocked · × = still needed · star = phantom job maxed
completionist.outside_zone: Enter South Horn or North Horn to see that zone’s field-note checklist.
completionist.survey_tooltip: Click: map flag only (go there yourself). Ctrl+click: flag + travel (walk, nearby aethernet, or Return when shorter). Not Illegal Mode. If Completionist is running, start/stop it again to resume automation.
completionist.survey_tooltip_flag_only: Click to place a map flag. Ctrl+click travel needs a ready navmesh.

sources.persistent_pots_nh: Daylight Pottery / In a Pot of Bother

automator.title: Illegal Mode
automator.refresh_pathfinding_tooltip: Drop the current route and plan a new one from where you are. Useful if you got stuck or walked somewhere manually.
automator.illegal_mode_off_left_zone: [BOCCHI] Left Occult Crescent — Illegal Mode Off
automator.pathfinding_refreshed_no_goal: [BOCCHI] Route cleared (nothing to go to right now)

mob_farmer.title: Mob Farmer
mob_farmer.configure_mobs: Pick enemies in /bocchi config → Mob Farmer.

pots_treasure.pause_tooltip: Stop moving for now, but keep this run. Press Resume when you’re ready.
pots_treasure.resume_tooltip: Continue pots and treasure from where you left off.
pots_treasure.off_left_zone: [BOCCHI] Left Occult Crescent — Pots & Treasure Off
pots_treasure.description: Does pot FATEs and pot chests, then treasure hunts until about 3 minutes before the next pot, waits near pots, and repeats. Does not do CEs or other FATEs. Use Pause to hold without ending the run; Stop ends it.
pots_treasure.requires_vnav: [BOCCHI] Pots & Treasure needs the vnavmesh plugin.
pots_treasure.resume_treasure_hunt_tooltip: Skip the wait and start another treasure hunt pass.
pots_treasure.no_active_fate: No pot FATE up right now.

treasure.title: Treasure Hunter
treasure.waiting_navmesh: Waiting for the map to be ready…
treasure.waiting_safe_window_detail: Treasure Hunt is paused for Ashkin or unsafe weather on South Horn. It resumes automatically when the window ends (or turn off Skip unsafe treasure windows in Treasure settings).
treasure.flag_resume_tooltip: Put a map flag on the coffer where the hunt will continue
treasure.recalculate_route_tooltip: Recalculate the treasure hunt route from your current position
treasure.managed_by_pots: Hunt is controlled by Pots & Treasure — start or stop it there.
treasure.managed_by_illegal_mode: Hunt is controlled by Illegal Mode (runs between activities).
treasure.use_fortune_carrot_tooltip: Use one Fortune Carrot from your inventory right now. Handy if the hunt is stuck near a chewed carrot.
